name: io.github.w1991e/sess
title: Sess
description: Your agent asks a person through a private link and gets back a typed, receipt-verified answer.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Sess developer API key (owner credential; never a tool argument).

environmentVariables.name: SESS_API_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Sess API origin. HTTPS only; default https://api.sess.si.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Local profile name that interaction handles are bound to.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the folder for durable interaction records.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_EXPECTED_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Trusted workspace for a runtime that does not return Sess-Workspace-Id.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_RECEIPT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Receipt issuer, only if it differs from the API origin.

environmentVariables.name: SESS_MCP_MAX_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Lower the 45000 ms ceiling of one sess_response wait.
